mapper.select: SELECT instance, organization_id, access_token FROM yunxiao_connection WHERE id = 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO yunxiao_connection (id, instance, organization_id, access_token) VALUES (1, #{instance}, #{organizationId}, #{accessToken}) ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET instance = excluded.instance, organization_id = excluded.organization_id, access_token = excluded.access_token
mapper.select: SELECT member_id, name FROM yunxiao_assignee_preference WHERE scope = #{scope} AND member_id <> ''
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO yunxiao_assignee_preference (scope, member_id, name) VALUES (#{scope}, #{assignee.memberId}, #{assignee.name}) ON CONFLICT (scope) DO UPDATE SET member_id = excluded.member_id, name = excluded.name
mapper.select: SELECT task_id, scope, child_id, label FROM yunxiao_binding
SELECT scope, child_id, label FROM yunxiao_binding WHERE task_id = #{taskId}
SELECT task_id FROM yunxiao_timer_task WHERE scope = #{scope} AND parent_id = #{parentId} AND display_title = #{title}
INSERT INTO task (title) VALUES (#{key}) RETURNING id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO yunxiao_timer_task (task_id, scope, parent_id, display_title) VALUES (#{taskId}, #{scope}, #{parentId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{title})
INSERT INTO yunxiao_auto_task (task_id, draft) VALUES (#{taskId}, #{draft}) ON CONFLICT (task_id) DO UPDATE SET draft = excluded.draft
mapper.sql: SELECT e.task_id, e.day, e.revision, t.display_title FROM yunxiao_auto_effort e JOIN yunxiao_timer_task t ON t.task_id = e.task_id
mapper.select: WHERE t.scope = #{scope} ORDER BY e.day, e.task_id
SELECT task_id FROM yunxiao_auto_effort WHERE day = #{day}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM yunxiao_auto_effort WHERE task_id = #{effort.taskId} AND day = #{effort.day} AND revision = #{effort.revision}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO yunxiao_binding (task_id, scope, child_id, label) VALUES (#{taskId}, #{binding.scope}, #{binding.childId}, #{binding.label}) ON CONFLICT (task_id) DO UPDATE SET label = excluded.label WHERE yunxiao_binding.scope = excluded.scope AND yunxiao_binding.child_id = excluded.child_id
mapper.select: INSERT INTO yunxiao_write (task_id, scope, operation, marker) VALUES (#{taskId}, #{scope}, #{operation}, #{marker}) ON CONFLICT (task_id, scope, operation) DO UPDATE SET marker = yunxiao_write.marker RETURNING marker, remote_id, marker = #{marker} AS fresh
mapper.update: UPDATE yunxiao_write SET remote_id = #{remoteId} WHERE marker = #{marker}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM yunxiao_write WHERE marker = #{marker} AND remote_id = ''
